# 2 Baruch Chapter 47 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Third Fast and Dialogue

---

**1** I, Baruch, sat down there and grieved over Babylon and over what had happened to our people. I wept for the many captives who had been carried away from Zion.

**2** And I cried out loudly: "O Lord, you who endure forever — you whose fire consumed Zion — please hear the prayer of your servant."

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic equivalence rendering. Prioritizes clarity and natural English flow while preserving the theological and narrative content of the Syriac source.*
